Chapter 181: Chapter 18: Sealing The Eye Of The North Sea, 120 Years Later (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 181: Chapter 18: Sealing the Eye of the North Sea, 120 Years Later (Subscription Requested)

“Do you know me?”

Lin Yuan immediately understood. It must be the world consciousness that notified the powerful beings around the Eye of the North Sea.

The world consciousness is aloof, even Ninth Realm and Tenth Realm powerhouses do not have the qualifications to contact it.

If it weren’t for the fact that Xiao Huo and the other two were about to die by Lin Yuan’s hand, the world consciousness would not have descended.

But it was different for the Eleventh Realm powerhouses.

The Eleventh Realm powerhouses can be said to be the limit of this world. For hundreds of thousands of years, the strongest were only at the Eleventh Realm.

...

Lin Yuan had made a deal with the world consciousness to come here and try to resolve the hidden dangers of the Eye of the North Sea.

The world consciousness naturally made prior arrangements with the Eleventh Realm powerhouses in this area to prevent any ‘mistaken’ incidents.

“Yes,”

Master Nalan and several vice-masters said respectfully.

At this moment, Master Nalan’s mind was shaken. It was not long ago that he received the directive from the ‘Heavenly Tao,’ instructing him and his people to welcome an important figure.

A person who might completely resolve the issue with the Eye of the North Sea.

Under the directive of the ‘Heavenly Tao,’ they all had to obey this person without any dissenting thoughts.

In short, after this person’s arrival, the several Eleventh Realm individuals and many Tenth Realm powerhouses on North Sea Island were all subject to this person’s commands.

Although Master Nalan found this puzzling, he could only comply.

“Very good.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

He was quite satisfied in his heart.

The world consciousness of this world had considered everything thoroughly.

But then again, given that this related to the future of this Heavenly Earth, the world consciousness would naturally try its best to avoid any accidents.

“However…”

Lin Yuan looked around.

The farther north he went, the more Lin Yuan could feel the concentration of Heavenly Earth Vital Energy increasing. Here, it was almost ten times that of the Five Domains Mainland.

This was not hard to understand.

For hundreds of thousands of years, the Eye of the North Sea had acted like a ‘black hole,’ devouring Heavenly Earth Primordial Qi from all directions.

This caused the concentration of Heavenly Earth Vital Energy in the Five Domains Mainland to continuously decline.

Where did all the Heavenly Earth Vital Energy go?

Naturally, it went into the mouth of the Eye of the North Sea.

However.

As the Eye of the North Sea consumed massive amounts of Heavenly Earth Vital Energy, the concentration of vital energy around it naturally rose dramatically.

Just like a Long River flowing into the sea, as the water flows into the ocean, it irrigates numerous fields along both banks.

Lin Yuan speculated that the concentration of Heavenly Earth Vital Energy where he was now was close to the peak from hundreds of thousands of years ago.

This level of Primordial Qi concentration increased the closer one was to the Eye of the North Sea.

“No wonder there are so many at the Tenth and Eleventh Realms.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In the Five Domains Mainland, a Tenth Realm powerhouse might be born every thousands or tens of thousands of years, and as for the Eleventh Realm? There has been none for fifty thousand years.

If not for the few ancient records, perhaps people would think the Eleventh Realm was a legend.

Yet near the Eye of the North Sea, Lin Yuan could sense the presences of dozens of Tenth Realm powerhouses and six Eleventh Realm powerhouses.

Among them were Master Nalan and the five vice-masters.

Master Nalan’s strength was at the peak of the Eleventh Realm, only a half step away from the Twelfth Realm.

If so many powerful beings were to emerge, it undoubtedly required an extremely high environmental demand;

However, with the rich Heavenly Earth Vital Energy here, under the beckoning of the Eye of the North Sea,

The thriving of so many powerful beings by converging all the world’s Primordial Qi here is not unthinkable.

“Lead me to the Eye of the North Sea.”

After asking a few casual questions, Lin Yuan directly said.

“This way, sir.”

Master Nalan immediately led the way for Lin Yuan personally.

The other five vice-masters also closely followed.

The group then headed towards the location of the Eye of the North Sea.

…

In the distance.

A plump man just watched as Lin Yuan, surrounded by Master Nalan and the five vice-masters, headed towards the direction of North Sea Island.

“Why are the Master and vice-masters so respectful…”

The plump man couldn’t believe it. Had it not been for seeing it with his own eyes, he could hardly imagine that the usually authoritative Master Nalan and the five vice-masters would exhibit such a ‘servile’ side.

“Who is that person?”

The plump man’s concentration once again focused on Lin Yuan.

Initially, the plump man thought Lin Yuan was a newcomer from the Five Domains Mainland at the ‘Tenth Realm.’

But now, it seemed his assumption was massively mistaken.

A mere newcomer at the ‘Tenth Realm’ wouldn’t cause a stir even for him, let alone for Master Nalan and the vice-masters.

“Ah, if only I didn’t have twenty more years of my guard duty, I would definitely follow and investigate….”

The plump man sighed; he was obligated to guard the tower for this century and couldn’t leave.

…

Under the guidance of Master Nalan and the five vice-masters,

Lin Yuan soon arrived in front of an ‘island.’

To call it an ‘island’ would be an understatement; it was more like a small continent.

Although it couldn’t compare with the Five Domains, it was home to several hundred million of the Human Race.

The auras of the dozens of Tenth Realm powerhouses Lin Yuan had sensed earlier came mostly from this island.

“This island, we all call it North Sea Island…” Master Nalan explained by his side.

“The Eye of the North Sea… is over there.”

Master Nalan raised his hand and pointed.

In the north of North Sea Island, a faint black line was visible. If one looked closely, it would appear as a deep abyss-like ‘void.’

Every moment, an immense amount of Heavenly Earth Vital Energy surged into this ‘void.’

Soon.

Master Nalan led Lin Yuan to the front of the Eye of the North Sea.

Compared to viewing it from a distance, being close to the Eye of the North Sea was even more awe-inspiring; it resembled a crack in the world, pitch-black as night.
